notes.title: How to Restart "As Long As It's Not Illegal from ACT i or ACT ii"
notes.content:
[h1]As Long As It's Not Illegal behaves a bit differently on Steam, so this announcement is to help anyone who may be having trouble restarting the game from ACT I after purchasing ACT II or the Last ACT[/h1]

[h3]To replay ACT I you must first uninstall "ACT II" and/or "The Last"[/h3]
Simply go to the library tab and select "As Long As It's Not Illegal: ACT I"
From there, Locate the DLC area on the right and select "Manage My DLC"
[list]

 
[h3]To play ACT I Again:[/h3]
[*] Uncheck ACT II and Last ACT
[/list]
[list]
[h3]To play ACT II Again:[/h3]
[*] Check ACT II 
[*] Uncheck Last ACT
[/list]
[list]
[h3]To play The Last ACT Again:[/h3]
[*] The Last ACT behaves as expected and all three can be installed by this point without issue
 
[/list]

This doesn't effect the carry over of choices and the game will still record what you've done in previous ACTs smoothly

Happy Gaming!

notes.title: As Long As It's Not Illegal Series Completion!
notes.content:
ACT II and ACT I have received small updates in the wake of the Last ACT coming out.

With all three ACTs, the series is completed, and the Last ACT is set to release VERY soon.
You can view it's page here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2459651/As_Long_As_Its_Not_Illegal_Last_ACT/]As Long As It's Not Illegal: Last ACT[/url]
